name: Adspirer Ads & Performance Marketing Agent
description:
Adspirer is your performance marketing and paid media agent — an AI performance marketer that works like a member of your team. Tell it what you want to achieve, and it understands the goal, builds the right campaigns across the right platforms, and runs them day to day.
Create campaigns through conversation, not dashboards. Adspirer turns an objective like "more demos under a $50 cost-per-lead" into well-structured campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and TikTok — then keeps working after launch. It paces spend so budgets land where you want them, shifts money toward what's converting, continuously harvests high-intent keywords and prunes the negatives draining budget, catches creative fatigue before it costs you, and flags anything that needs a human call. 
You set the strategy and approve the moves — new campaigns start paused, so nothing goes live without you. Adspirer manages multiple brands and accounts, and it's always adding new ad platforms.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adspirer Ads & Performance Marketing Agent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adspirer Ads & Performance Marketing Agent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.adspirer.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adspirer Ads & Performance Marketing Agent MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adspirer Ads & Performance Marketing Agent lists 18 MCP tools, including amazon_ads, audit_conversion_tracking, chatgpt_ads, get_campaign_performance, get_connections_status, get_meta_campaign_performance, get_tool_schema, get_usage_status, google_ads, google_analytics, klaviyo, and linkedin_ads.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adspirer Ads & Performance Marketing Agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adspirer Ads & Performance Marketing Agent in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adspirer Ads & Performance Marketing Agent MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adspirer Ads & Performance Marketing Agent requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Adspirer Ads & Performance Marketing Agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adspirer Ads & Performance Marketing Agent is developed by Adspirer. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
